source_columns_appended.spin_axis: Statcast spin axis in degrees; source for spin_axis_sin = sin(rad), spin_axis_cos = cos(rad) with rad = deg2rad(spin_axis).
source_columns_appended.balls: Statcast balls; used with strikes to map z_count via feature_engineering.z_count_from_balls_strikes.
source_columns_appended.strikes: Statcast strikes; used with balls to map z_count.
